thread:
riley: Hey team — putting a short manager+HR onboarding checklist in the thread for Jo starting next Tue. Aim: Day 1 no blocker, Week 1 outcome, clear 30/60/90. Add owners or quick notes.

sam: Thanks Riley. I'll set the Day 1 1:1 and pick a mentor. Planning a tiny starter ticket touching docs + CI.

riley: Paste for managers:
```
Pre-start (48h):
- IT: laptop + SSO + VPN requested
- Slack + calendar invites (People Ops)
- Repo access requested (DevEx)
- Manager: starter task + acceptance criteria ready

Day 1:
- 09:00 welcome (People Ops) + paperwork overview
- 10:00 env setup (DevEx/IT) pair session
- 11:00 team intros (round robin, 10m each)
- Lunch w/ mentor
- 14:00 starter task assigned (small PR)
- 16:30 EOD 30m sync w/ manager (clarify goals)

Week 1 goals:
- Run local stack + smoke tests
- Merge or close starter PR
- Meet PM/SRE/Security briefly

30/60/90 (manager to make measurable):
- 30d: ship small change, 2 PRs merged, onboarding checklist complete
- 60d: own a small area, measurable improvement (perf/tests)
- 90d: lead a demo or rollout, document outcomes
```

riley: Owners: People Ops (paperwork/cal), IT (hardware/accounts), DevEx (env/repos), Manager (mentor/goals), Security (data access).

it-bot: IT ticket #13579 opened for newbie.jo — laptop + SSO + VPN. ETA: 48 hours.

newbie.jo: Quick Q: who approves dataset/sandbox access for evals? Need to run a small experiment as starter task.

ben: @newbie.jo Security requires manager approval + brief justification. Use https://internal.redwood.dev/sec/request-access and cc your manager. NDA may be needed for customer data.

asha: I'll add repo + onboarding README: git.internal/redwood/onboard. If hardware delayed I can provide a devcontainer so Jo can start immediately.

liz: Mentor checklist (short): intro team, share starter task context, be available 45m/day Week 1, quick PR feedback, lunch intro. I'll DM the template to @sam.

sam: I'll nominate @liz as mentor and set measurable acceptance criteria in the Day 1 1:1. Example 30d = 2 PRs merged + one doc update.

newbie.jo: Awesome, thanks everyone! One last: is there a compact 30/60/90 template I can copy into my doc?

riley: Yep — /hr/templates/30-60-90-brief.md. Use concrete metrics and a success checkbox for each item.

asha: Ping me if the repo invite doesn't work; I'll add you manually.

riley: Great — I'll update the master checklist with these owners and push calendar invites once IT confirms provisioning. :white_check_mark:

newbie.jo: Appreciate it! Looking forward to Day 1 :wave:
